handoff_instructions: M2-T18 provider route management complete. Added: permission `provider_route.manage` (owner-only, packages/domain/src/permissions.ts); domain type `ProviderRoute` + `registerProviderRouteInput` schema (normalizes address to E.164, enforces twilio->sms / vapi->voice) in packages/domain; new packages/core/src/services/provider-routes.ts with listProviderRoutes/registerProviderRoute/deactivateProviderRoute, all owner-only via ctx.authorize and scoped by organization_id (no manual writeAudit needed - provider_routes already has a DB audit trigger from migration 0012); registerProviderRoute calls the existing requeueUnroutableWebhookEvents in the same transaction as the insert. Settings UI: new 'Phone numbers' section (apps/web/src/app/(tenant)/settings/page.tsx) with register/deactivate forms, wired through new server actions in apps/web/src/app/actions/tenant.ts. No migration changed: provider_routes' RLS (staff can read, no client writes) and audit trigger already existed. Tests: packages/core/test/provider-routes.test.ts (owner-only, cross-tenant isolation via NotFoundError/ForbiddenError, duplicate active address -> ConflictError, and unroutable webhook events re-queued and reprocessed on registration) plus a policy.test.ts assertion that only owner has the new permission. format:check/lint/typecheck/test all pass repo-wide. Next: M2-T19 (receptionist runtime: assistant-request), which depends on this task's provider_routes resolution.
